correctness.rationale: Fresh audit of the repaired theorem: the shore inequalities exclude sizes below five and force the two five-set patterns. In the two-point case the three forced lines cover exactly the seven unselected points and concur at the unselected third point of the omitted direction, which violates restraint; duality handles the other shore. Independent Python enumerated all 262144 subsets; all stated polynomial coefficients agree, with 207 optima at six. It considered both shores and all 9! point-image bijections on each; connected bipartiteness and distinct line-neighborhood triples make this an exhaustive automorphism check, not an inference from finding 216 permutations. The five orbits have the reported sizes. The two three-edge types have induced degrees (1,1,1,1,1,1) at mask 3682 and (0,0,1,1,1,3) at mask 3591. Comparing the actual isolated-state sets for both rules gives precisely their union. Pairwise exchange checks and BFS from every main-component state verify edge totals 432/324 and eccentricities 6/8. The full corrected checker was run successfully.
